kill_fact: The 'deep value / special-situation' EDGE does not exist: the only re-rating catalyst (record 2025 result + 39% dividend hike to EUR 12.50) is fully spent, and the screener's cheapness signals (P/FCF 4.7x, DCF fair value 776, 'net cash 55.78B') are confirmed IFRS 17 / policyholder-float accounting artifacts, not margin of safety. Consensus is already a buy near EUR 285 vs ~EUR 240, so what remains is a fairly-priced quality compounder (~+13% upside + ~5% yield vs ~-11% downside), not a mispricing. The moat-erosion screen (earns_below_cost_of_capital=true) is a FALSE POSITIVE: primary filings show ROE 21.4% FY2025 / 21.2% Q1-26 on a 254% solvency ratio and a 3.2% group cost ratio (industry-low) — returns are durably high and rising, not eroding, so the terminal-erosion kill does not land; the franchise is confirmed durable. The value case survives only as quality-at-a-fair-price, capped at conviction 3.
